# School Admin and HQ
Resolve school membership and scoped admin authority before writes. School Admin may manage only authorized school scope. HQ visibility and HQ authority are separate concepts; broad visibility must not imply founder-sensitive powers. Owner/founder actions, delegated partner-admin permissions and operational review queues must remain explicit and auditable. UI status must reconcile with backend truth and distinguish available, working, waiting, blocked, stopped, certified and stale states.
